FIND(1)                     General Commands Manual                     FIND(1)

NAME
     find - search for files in a directory hierarchy

SYNOPSIS
     find [-H] [-L] [-P] [-D debugopts] [-Olevel] [starting-point...] [expression]

DESCRIPTION
     This manual page documents the GNU version of find.

OPTIONS
     -D debugopts
            Print diagnostic information.

     -help, --help
            Print a summary of the command-line usage of find and exit.

     -version, --version
            Print the find version number and exit.

EXPRESSION
     -daystart
            Measure times from the beginning of today rather than from 24 hours
            ago.

     -regextype type
            Changes the regular expression syntax understood by -regex and
            -iregex tests.

     -maxdepth levels
            Descend at most levels directories below the starting-points.

     -mindepth levels
            Do not apply any tests or actions at levels less than levels.

     -amin n
            File was last accessed less than, more than or exactly n minutes
            ago.

     -name pattern
            Base of file name matches shell pattern pattern.

     -type c
            File is of type c.

     -empty
            File is empty and is either a regular file or a directory.
